Target company: Microsoft (MSFT). Microsoft develops software and cloud services including Windows, Microsoft 365 and Azure, and operates gaming, business-software and related technology businesses.

Focal announcement: Microsoft Build 2025: The age of AI agents and building the open agentic web.

Decision cutoff: 2025-05-19T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Microsoft Build 2025: The age of AI agents and building the open agentic web. Published date: 2025-05-19. URL: https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2025/05/19/microsoft-build-2025-the-age-of-ai-agents-and-building-the-open-agentic-web.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Hear the news as an AI-generated audio overview made using Microsoft 365 Copilot. For example, 15 million developers are already using GitHub Copilot, and features like agent mode and code review are streamlining the way they code, check, deploy and troubleshoot. Hundreds of thousands of customers are using Microsoft 365 Copilot to help research, brainstorm and develop solutions, and more than 230,000 organizations — including 90% of the Fortune 500 — have already used Copilot Studio to build AI agents and automations. As the home of over 150 million developers, this reinforces our commitment to open, collaborative, AI-powered software development. With the general availability of Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, Microsoft is bringing new capabilities to empower professional developers to orchestrate multiple specialized agents to handle complex tasks, including bringing Semantic Kernel and AutoGen into a single, developer-focused SDK and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) and Model Context Protocol (MCP) support.
